app.name: Solenna
app.offline: You're offline, so you're seeing the last data this device loaded. Changes can be saved once you're back online.
app.offlineNoData: You're offline, and this device has no saved data to show yet.
app.offlineSignIn: You're offline. Signing in needs a connection.
nav.label: Main navigation
login.title: Sign in
login.tagline: Track your weight and cycle, privately.
login.accountDeleted: Your account and all its data have been deleted.
weight.title: Weight
weight.invalid: Check the date and weight: the date can't be before 1900 or in the future, and the weight must be between 20 and 400 kg.
cycle.title: Cycle
cycle.empty: Log your first period to see your cycle, phases and predictions.
cycle.disclaimer: Predictions are estimates based on your logged periods (calendar method). They can't tell exactly when you ovulate and must not be used as contraception.
cycle.ongoingTooLong: This period has been marked as ongoing for {days}. Select its last bleeding day in the calendar and tap “Bleeding stopped this day”.
cycle.spottingText: Spotting doesn't start a new cycle. Once real bleeding is logged, that day becomes cycle day 1.
cycle.overlap: This would overlap another period. Change or delete that one first.
cycle.invalid: That doesn't fit: a period is at most 15 days long, and bleeding strength can only be set on period days.
cycle.staleOngoing: A period that started more than 15 days ago can't still be ongoing. Select its last bleeding day and tap “Bleeding stopped this day” first.
cycle.phaseMenstrualText: The uterine lining is shed, from cycle day 1 to the last bleeding day.
cycle.phaseFollicularText: Follicles in the ovaries mature and the uterine lining rebuilds. Energy often rises.
cycle.phaseOvulationText: An egg is released and can be fertilised for about a day. The fertile window ends with it.
cycle.phaseLutealText: From ovulation until the next period, usually about 14 days. PMS symptoms may appear near the end.
cycle.phaseUnknownOverdue: While your period is overdue, the phase can't be estimated: ovulation probably happened later than expected.
cycle.phaseUnknownShort: The phase after the period can't be estimated: the cycles are too short, or the period too long, for the calendar method.
cycle.normalVariation: Expected on {date}. Cycles often vary by a few days, so this is usually nothing to worry about.
cycle.noOvulationEstimateText: Your cycles are shorter than 21 days, or your period lasts into the estimated ovulation, so the calendar method can't estimate ovulation or a fertile window.
cycle.typicalCycleFewPeriods: Typical cycle length until you log a second period.
cycle.typicalCycleGaps: Typical cycle length: the gaps between your logged periods look like missed entries (under 15 or over 60 days).
cycle.skippedGaps: Gaps much longer than your usual cycle are left out as missed entries.
cycle.typicalPeriodLength: Typical period length until a logged period has ended.
account.title: Account
account.logoutFailed: Couldn't sign out. Please try again.
account.removeLocal: Remove my data from this device
account.removeLocalHint: Signing out needs a connection. This removes your data from this device now, but you stay signed in: once the server is reachable, the app opens your account again. Sign out then to end the session.
account.saveFailed: Couldn't save the setting. Please try again.
account.trackCycleHint: When off, the Cycle screen is hidden. Your logged periods are kept.
account.showFertilityHint: Fertile days and the estimated ovulation on the calendar and in the events.
account.exportText: Download everything Solenna stores about you as a JSON file.
account.exportFailed: Couldn't export your data. Please try again.
account.deleteText: Deleting your account permanently removes it with all your weigh-ins and periods. This cannot be undone.
account.deleteConfirm: Delete your account and all your data for good?
account.deleteFailed: Couldn't delete your account. Please try again.
